Norris Beauty Clinic’s content production policy regarding aesthetic medicine

Cosmetic treatments such as medical diets and double plastic surgery are important themes that are closely related to each individual's health condition, constitution, cost, and schedule.

We create content with an emphasis on reliability, neutrality, and safety so that our readers can calmly make choices that are suitable for them and prepare for advance counseling.

Explaining the difference between burial method and incision method for double plastic surgery

Double plastic surgery is a big deal.burial methodandincision methodThere are two types, and the suitability for each type depends on the condition of the eyelids and the desired finish.

It is not that one is better than the other, but it is important to choose according to the thickness of your eyelids and your desire for double durability.Choose a treatment you won't regretIt leads to

Characteristics of burial method and incision method and how to choose according to eyelid
  • The burial method has short downtime and is often chosen by first-timers.
  • The incision method has the advantage of being semi-permanent and is suitable for thick eyelids.
  • The appropriate treatment changes depending on the thickness of your eyelids, single layer, or deep double eyelids.
  • If you are concerned about how difficult it is to remove, choose a multi-point fastening plan.

The burial method isShort downtimeIt is characterized by its simplicity, and the incision method isDurability and stability of finishhas strengths.

Before receiving counseling at a clinic in Fukuoka, understanding the characteristics of each treatment and its suitability for your eyelids will help your consultation with the doctor go smoothly.

The burial method is a procedure where a thin medical thread is used to create a double eyelid without cutting the eyelid.

The burial method involves removing the skin and inner tissues of the eyelids.medical threadThis is a procedure that creates a double line by tying the

Since no scalpel is used, there is less stress on the skin, and the treatment time is short for both eyes.Around 30 minutesis the standard.

Swelling peaks from the day after the procedure to the second day, and in most casesAbout 1 weekThis allows you to settle into a state where it is difficult for others to notice you.

This procedure is often chosen by people who cannot take long breaks from work or who are considering double plastic surgery for the first time.

On the other hand, due to physical stimulation to the eyelids and weight gain/loss,Risk of threads coming loose or coming offThere is.

The burial method is not a permanent procedure, and the threads may loosen after a few years. Please check whether there is a guarantee system and the conditions for re-treatment before signing a contract.

The major difference compared to the incision method is that even if the threads are removed, the eyelids will return to their original condition.

However, many clinics have multiple plans for the burial method, depending on the number of points and threads to be fastened.

Generally speaking, the more points you fasten, the more it will affect your eyelids.Fixing forceThis increases the tension and makes it difficult for the thread to loosen.

2 point fasteningand4 point fasteningWhen comparing , the 4-point fastener can spread the risk of the thread coming off, so it is recommended for those who are concerned about the difficulty of the thread coming off.Multi-point fastening planis suitable.

Advantages of having a large number of fastening points
  • The higher the number of points, the higher the fixing force and the less likely the thread will loosen.
  • 4-point fixing can spread the risk more than 2-point fixing

The name of the plan and the definition of points differ depending on the clinic, so please check the "How many points should I keep?」「how many threads to use”, it will be easier to compare plans.

The incision method is a procedure that creates semi-permanent double lines by cutting the skin and treating internal fat and muscles.

The incision method is a procedure in which the skin of the eyelid is incised with a scalpel, excess fat and tissue are removed, and a double line is sutured.

Because the tissue itself is physically fixed, there is no concept of the thread loosening, and there is no double line.semi-permanentLasts for.

By the time the swelling subsides and the finish stabilizesApproximately 3 to 6 monthsTherefore, downtime is longer than with the burial method.

The scar may remain red and hard for about a month after the procedure, and many people feel reluctant to appear in public during this period.

Once the incision method is used, it is very difficult to return to the original state, so please thoroughly share the image of the final result with your doctor before proceeding with the procedure.

However, the result after the swelling has completely subsided is natural and stable.Those who are concerned about the thickness of their eyelidsThey tend to be more satisfied.

Although the treatment cost is higher than the burial method, there is no need to incur future re-treatment costs.Reduce long-term costsThere are cases.
